To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a bivariate Bayes model is more efficient than a univariate model when the two diseases are related and the bivariate model can be used to improve the estimation of the mortality rates of one of the diseases when the second disease is related to the first one.

the bivariate procedure is better than the univariate procedure in terms of mean squared error, and the bivariate procedure has better coverage of the true values of the mortality rates than the univariate one.

(1) The bivariate Bayes procedure is superior to a univariate Bayes procedure in terms of the optimal property and a Monte Carlo study; (2) The bivariate method is also superior to the univariate Bayes method for analyzing real data; and (3) In terms of the Bayes factor, the bivariate procedure is also superior to a univariant method.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the estimation of the mortality rates for a single disease using information from a second similar disease.
developing a bivariate Bayes approach for estimating the mortality rate for a given population using additional information from another disease.
the development and application of bivariate Bayes models to estimate the mortality rates of diseases.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the bivariate Bayes procedure is superior to the univariate Bayes procedure.
the use of bivariate information is a significant improvement over the univariate method.
the bivariate Bayes procedure is the best of the procedures considered for the estimation of mortality rates of two diseases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the bivariate Bayes procedure is superior to the univariate one in estimating the mortality rates, and the twofold CAR model provides a good fit to the data.
the bivariate Bayes procedure with the CAR model is a useful and powerful method for improving the estimate of mortality rates.
the bivariate Bayes procedure provides a more efficient way of estimating mortality rates for two diseases.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of additional information from a related disease can improve the estimation of mortality rates.
a joint model that uses the information from the two diseases simultaneously can improve the estimation of mortality rates of a disease of interest.
the bivariate Bayes procedure can be used to improve the estimates of the mortality rate for a single disease by using additional information from another disease.
